summary: Frontend-only PWA testing for IDGAF Tracker: verified confetti background pattern visibility, removal of 🌿 leaf from empty states, Cycle-view copy additions, streak pill logic, daily reminder settings persistence, custom rating sparklines, provider-section toggles in the Share/QR modal, and History search. All 8 requested features/bugs pass. No console errors on any page. Regression: nav Today/Dashboard/Cycle/History all functional; showView() JS routing works.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav tabs (Today/Dashboard/Cycle/History) in index.html lines 63-66 do NOT have data-testid attributes — they use onclick="showView(...)" only. Testing agents currently must fall back to page.evaluate("showView('dashboard')"). Consider adding data-testid="nav-today", nav-dashboard, nav-cycle, nav-history for cleaner Playwright selectors.

extras.js #150 uses module-scope `_customSparks` object that grows without cleanup between renders — Chart.getChart+destroy handles the canvas, but the map itself leaks orphaned entries when a custom rating is deleted. Low priority.

Custom rating storage lives in two places: `idgaf_custom_ratings` (definitions) and `day.customWellness[id]` (values). Naming mismatch between 'custom_ratings' and 'customWellness' is easy to trip over — consider renaming to `customRatings` on both sides for consistency.
share-qr modal encoder debounces at ~250ms — worked reliably in tests. Confirmed canvas.width changed from 534 → 510 after unchecking symptoms, proving re-encryption fires.

verified_test_matrix.confetti_pattern_visible: PASS — body::before uses url(memphis-tile.svg + memphis-tile-b.svg); .card bg = rgba(255,255,255,0.88). Pattern visible in screenshot.
verified_test_matrix.no_leaf_in_empty_states: PASS — Timeline empty state uses 📼 (VHS), Dashboard empty state uses 📊 (bar chart). No 🌿 in either. (One 🌿 in DOM is legitimate: 'Vaginal dryness' symptom tile in SYMS[].)
verified_test_matrix.cycle_view_copy: PASS — 'Surfing the Crimson Wave' AND 'Aunt Flo, meet the dashboard.' both present in #periodView.
verified_test_matrix.streak_pill_5_days: PASS — text='🔥 5 day streak — you got this', display=inline-flex, computeCurrentStreak()=5.
verified_test_matrix.streak_pill_2_days_hidden: PASS — display=none, computeCurrentStreak()=2, pill not rendered.
verified_test_matrix.reminder_settings: PASS — [data-testid=reminder-settings-toggle] collapsed by default. Toggle on shows perm msg 'On. We'll ping you at 20:00...'. Time '21:00' persists to idgaf_reminder_time_hhmm='21:00' and idgaf_reminder_enabled='1'. Toggle off writes idgaf_reminder_enabled='0'.
verified_test_matrix.custom_rating_creation: PASS — [data-testid=add-custom-rating-btn] opens modal with label + emoji inputs. Save persists {id, label:'Focus', icon:'🎯'} to idgaf_custom_ratings and renders slider in customRatingsContainer.
verified_test_matrix.custom_sparklines_render: PASS — #customSparklinesContainer contains .spark-card with label 'Focus', icon 🎯, canvas [data-testid=custom-spark-<id>] with dimensions 896×60. With no custom ratings, container is empty string.
verified_test_matrix.custom_sparklines_latest_value: PASS — When day.customWellness[id]=7 is set, sparkLatest_<id> textContent = '7/10'. (Note: values stored under day.customWellness, not day.customRatings.)
verified_test_matrix.provider_sections_initial: PASS — <details data-testid=provider-sections> contains 5 checkboxes all checked by default: symptoms/wellness/custom/notes/overnight.
verified_test_matrix.provider_section_toggle_symptoms: PASS — Unchecking [data-testid=provider-section-symptoms] removes 'Most frequent symptoms:' from #weeklySummaryText (len 397→341). Canvas width changed 534→510 confirming re-encryption. Re-checking restores block (341→397).
verified_test_matrix.history_search_note_filter: PASS — With 5 seeded days, [data-testid=history-search] value 'headache' filters #historyList .hi to 1 visible row (day with note 'test note headache'). Empty value restores all 5.
verified_test_matrix.history_search_symptom_filter: PASS — All 5 seeded days had 'Hot flash' event, so 'Hot flash' search returns 5 visible — correct behavior. filterHistory looks at both note text and symptom labels.
verified_test_matrix.no_console_errors: PASS — no console errors after correcting the test seed shape (events need {sym: <SYMS index>, ts, time}).

seed_data_creation: Playwright injected 5 consecutive days via localStorage keys idgaf_day_YYYY-MM-DD with shape {events:[{sym:0,ts,time,intensity}], wellness:{0..5}, note}. Custom rating seeded via idgaf_custom_ratings + day.customWellness[id]. Notification API stubbed via add_init_script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 features from the request work end-to-end. Nav tabs do NOT have data-testid — use page.evaluate("showView('today'|'dashboard'|'period'|'history')") for programmatic navigation. Custom rating slider values are stored under day.customWellness[id], not day.customRatings. Streak pill selectors: [data-testid=streak-pill]. When testing the timeline empty state, ensure today's day key exists with events:[] (not just missing) OR clear all data — otherwise seeded events show and hide the empty state. The 🌿 emoji still appears once in the DOM legitimately — it is the icon for the 'Vaginal dryness' symptom tile in SYMS[]; only empty-state uses of 🌿 were removed.
